map.EDSS是多发性硬化最常用的残疾评估量表，也是临床试验主要终点。EDSS≤3.5: EDSS is the most commonly used disability scale for multiple sclerosis and also a primary clinical-trial endpoint. EDSS≤3.5 is mild disability; 4.0 is a key turning point where walking ability begins to be limited; ≥6.0 needs an assistive device. EDSS≤4.0 is based on FS scores; ≥4.5 is mainly based on walking ability. Can guide disease-modifying therapy (DMT) selection and efficacy assessment.
